title: Choosing music over athletics
summary: Despite athletic ability, he realized the limits of success and chose music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So that's where my athletic participation you might say started. I think my whole awareness of being a person and making some decisions for myself starting during this same time of the age 12, and I began playing the violin, and participating in sports, realizing that I did have some ability in this field. But however, the irony of it, and I think the significant part of this part of my conversation is that how even knowing of this athletic ability, and also
realizing the limitations of being successful, I chose music, and it became my final decision even though I went from that to other things in the course of my schooling during this period.
